remarks: Open, Bright, Fabulous AND located in the sought-after Palmer Square community - across the street from one of Stamford's most popular public Golf Courses! Enjoy life in a meticulously maintained enclave with economic gas heat, central air + No ADDITIONAL FEES! Sun drenched and open, this apartment feels like your own home, with private entrance & extra windows, you'll also enjoy designer features such as: Entertainer's open Kitchen W/Stainless Steel Appliances & Granite Counter tops, a spacious living/dining area and private washer + dryer. On-Site Management provides 24-Hour Security & Parking for upto 2-Cars. Pets are welcome with the following guidelines 2 Dogs  35 Lbs., 1 Dog 60 lbs., or 1-dog + 1-Cat or 2-Cats OK. $300 fully refundable pet deposit per pet required. Palmer Square is a No Smoking Community. Interested parties please complete a Palmer Square application uploaded in supplements, and supply a credit check through Applyconnect only.
